references.title: de.wikipedia: Roswitha
references.supports: A female given name from OHG hrōd 'Ruhm' and swinth 'stark'

notes.rationale: Effi's servant's given name (Fem). No dictionary splits it within German, and a PROPN has no Source (ADR 0050 gives Sources to NOUN, VERB and ADJ only), so it is a bottom word: the Root roswitha and the zero ending, since PROPN has an ending slot (ADR 0051).
